gen-irish-grover-gf-nata-sans: Playful and sturdy, Irish Grover stands tall with softly varied strokes and open-throated letters. Nata Sans follows with wire-thin lines and wide curves, a technical-pen steadiness that lets the heading do the clowning.
gen-irish-grover-gf-nobile: Chunky, friendly and a touch wobbly, Irish Grover has diagonals pressed slightly thinner than its verticals. And Nobile, a plain sans with open chalk-arc mouths and caps barely above its lowercase, stays out of the way.
gen-irish-grover-gf-nokora: Soft, sturdy and quietly cheerful, Irish Grover shows only a faint thick-and-thin shift in its strokes. Nokora brings the real strength: a dark, thick stripe of sans-serif lowercase with an s that never tightens.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Playful, mostly. Irish Grover keeps its contrast mild while Noto Kufi Arabic, a modern sans with a welcoming gap in every c, gives the pair its best quality: friendliness that never turns loud.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans: Irish Grover draws its lines with a barely tilted nib. Noto Sans fills the line with big lowercase and a wide-open c, so for the heading, try going large and letting the sans-serif body stay modest.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, with a sans lowercase that stands tall and full. Irish Grover earns its keep big and short.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjo: Fun and a little organic, Irish Grover holds a small, steady difference in stroke thickness across its tall, sturdy lowercase. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined is the tidy sans: generous curve gaps, restrained case heights.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs reads modern and plain, its terminals pointing outward and its x-height rising close to the cap height. Irish Grover adds a soft weight gradient along each curve, which gives the page some personality.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic is open and tall in its small letters. Irish Grover handles the personality with its soft-curved, sturdy lowercase, while the plain sans body simply makes the words easy to take in.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Irish Grover brings a gentle taper from stem to joint. It earns its keep big and short, where its sturdy, open-throated lowercase can carry a few words with plenty of character.
